page_title: Amnesia Marijuana Strain - Kind Green Buds

source_page_metadata.description: Explore the Amnesia marijuana strain - THC levels, genetics, terpene profile, effects, flavor, and grow tips.

article_blocks.text: Strain Type: Sativa-dominant hybrid
Genetics: Skunk #1 × Cinderella 99 × Jack Herer
Breeder: Soma Seeds
THC Content: 20–25%
CBD Content: Low (<1%)
Terpene Profile: Terpinolene , Limonene , Caryophyllene
Primary Flavors: Citrus, earthy, spicy, herbal
Flowering Time (Indoor): 9–11 weeks
Flowering Time (Outdoor): Late October
Indoor Yield: 450–600 g/m²
Outdoor Yield: 500–700 g/plant
Grow Difficulty: Moderate

Within the family of Haze-influenced cannabis varieties, Amnesia occupies an important place in marijuana culture. The strain became widely recognized in European coffee shops during the 1990s and early 2000s, where its energetic high and distinctive citrus aroma helped define the appeal of modern sativa-dominant weed . While many hybrids lean heavily toward physical sedation, this cultivar emphasizes mental clarity and uplifting effects.

The plant produces long, resin-coated flowers that carry a bright fragrance combining citrus peel, spice, and earthy haze notes. Consumers often gravitate toward this strain when they want an experience that stimulates the mind rather than slows the body. Its ability to deliver strong potency while maintaining a clear-headed quality has allowed it to remain a staple in cannabis menus around the world.
Genetics and Lineage

The precise genetic origins of Amnesia have been debated over time because early Haze breeding involved multiple underground cultivators. However, the most widely accepted lineage traces the cultivar to crosses involving Skunk #1, Cinderella 99, and Jack Herer genetics, all of which contribute elements associated with classic Haze strains. Soma Seeds helped stabilize a widely recognized version of the plant, allowing it to gain international popularity.

Skunk #1 plays an important role in the hybrid’s genetic makeup. This legendary cannabis strain was one of the first stable hybrids widely distributed in the modern marijuana market. Its inclusion contributes structural stability, moderate flowering times, and a faint skunky aroma that can occasionally appear beneath the citrus haze profile.

Cinderella 99 and Jack Herer bring strong sativa characteristics into the mix. Cinderella 99 contributes bright tropical and citrus terpenes, while Jack Herer—another Haze-influenced strain—adds the cerebral energy that defines the high. Together, these parents produce a hybrid that maintains the stimulating qualities of traditional Haze varieties while remaining manageable enough for modern cultivation.
Effects and Experience

The experience often begins quickly with a noticeable shift in mental energy. Within minutes, the mind tends to feel brighter and more alert. Many consumers describe an initial sensation of mental expansion where ideas flow easily and conversation becomes more engaging. This stage of the high often feels lively and motivating rather than heavy or sedating.

As the experience deepens, the mental stimulation becomes more immersive. Creative thinking and curiosity often increase, which can make the strain appealing for artistic activities or brainstorming sessions. Unlike some powerful cannabis varieties that overwhelm the senses, the cerebral effects of this cultivar typically remain structured and functional.

A gentle body relaxation eventually appears beneath the mental buzz, though it rarely dominates the experience. Muscles may loosen slightly, allowing the body to feel comfortable while the mind remains active. Because the physical effects stay relatively mild, many weed enthusiasts prefer this cultivar during daytime hours when they want a boost of energy and mood enhancement.
Medical Benefits

Medical cannabis patients often choose this strain for its uplifting psychological effects. The mental stimulation may help counteract fatigue or low motivation, making it appealing for individuals who struggle with daytime lethargy. By promoting a brighter mental outlook, the strain can provide support for those dealing with stress or mood-related challenges.

Anxiety reduction is another area where the cultivar may offer benefits when consumed in moderate doses. The euphoric mental lift can help shift attention away from persistent worries, allowing patients to feel more relaxed and mentally balanced. Because the high tends to remain clear-headed, it can provide relief without excessive sedation.

The mild body relaxation associated with the strain may also assist with minor physical discomfort. While not typically used for heavy pain management, the gentle soothing effect can help ease tension headaches, muscle tightness, or lingering physical stress. Many medical marijuana patients appreciate this balanced combination of mental uplift and physical comfort.
Flavor Profile and Aroma

One of the most recognizable aspects of Amnesia is its vivid citrus aroma. When the buds are opened or ground, the scent releases a bright burst of lemon peel and sweet orange zest. This refreshing fragrance immediately signals the strain’s strong Haze heritage.

Beneath the citrus layer lies a more complex aromatic foundation. Caryophyllene introduces a subtle peppery spice that adds depth to the scent, while myrcene contributes earthy herbal undertones. Some phenotypes also display faint hints of pine and incense, giving the strain a classic haze-like fragrance that feels both fresh and slightly exotic.

The flavor mirrors these aromas during consumption. The inhale often carries a smooth blend of citrus sweetness and herbal haze notes. As the smoke or vapor leaves the palate, a lingering spice and earthy pine flavor becomes more noticeable. This evolving taste profile creates a balanced experience that keeps the flavor interesting from start to finish.
Growing Information

Cultivating Amnesia can be rewarding but requires patience due to its sativa-dominant growth characteristics. The plant often exhibits vigorous vertical growth during the vegetative stage , which means indoor growers may need to manage height through training techniques such as topping or low-stress training.

The flowering phase typically lasts around ten to eleven weeks indoors. During this time, the plant develops elongated buds that are heavily coated with trichomes. Unlike dense indica flowers, these buds tend to form slightly looser clusters, which improves airflow and reduces the risk of mold in humid environments.

Outdoor growers often achieve the best results in warm climates with long growing seasons. In Mediterranean-style environments, harvest usually occurs in late October. The plant produces strong citrus aromas as it matures, so odor control may be necessary for indoor cultivation. When grown under optimal conditions with strong lighting and balanced nutrients , the plant produces highly aromatic flowers rich in resin.
FAQ
Is Amnesia a sativa or indica strain? This cultivar is generally classified as a sativa-dominant hybrid. The effects emphasize mental stimulation and creativity rather than heavy body sedation.
How strong is Amnesia weed? THC levels commonly range from 20% to 25%. Because of this potency, the strain can produce strong cerebral effects, especially for individuals with low tolerance.
What does Amnesia taste like? The flavor profile combines bright citrus notes such as lemon and orange with earthy haze spice and subtle pine undertones.

Why is it called Amnesia? The name reflects the powerful cerebral effects associated with the strain’s Haze genetics. The intense mental stimulation can feel overwhelming for inexperienced cannabis consumers.
Is Amnesia good for daytime use? Yes. Many marijuana enthusiasts choose this strain during the daytime because its uplifting and energizing effects help maintain focus and motivation.
Final Thoughts on Amnesia

Amnesia remains one of the most recognizable Haze-influenced cannabis strains in the world. Its energetic cerebral high, citrus-forward terpene profile, and long-standing presence in European cannabis culture have secured its reputation as a classic sativa-dominant hybrid. Even as newer dessert-style strains gain popularity, this cultivar continues to attract enthusiasts who appreciate traditional haze flavors and uplifting effects.

The strain’s balanced combination of mental stimulation and mild physical relaxation makes it particularly versatile. Recreational cannabis users often enjoy its creativity-enhancing qualities, while medical marijuana patients value the mood-lifting effects that can help ease stress and fatigue.

For anyone exploring the broader world of marijuana genetics, this cultivar offers a clear example of what classic Haze breeding can produce. Its complex lineage, vibrant terpene profile, and energetic experience illustrate why it has remained a respected strain for decades within the global cannabis community.
